title: Coolisses
description: The app that helps you discover new musicians differently
descriptionWithMark: The app that helps you <mark>discover new musicians</mark> differently

sections.label: Overview
sections.paragraph: Coolisses is an intimate app designed to <mark>help you discover emerging artists through their creative process,</mark> giving you the space to take your time and build a genuine connection with them.
sections.team:
Designers: Lou CARDON
Developers: Françoise PHAM, César SAINT-LO
sections.role:
Contributed to concept creation
Designed and prototyped the user experience and interface
Wrote and moderated usability tests

sections.label: Brief
sections.title: Designing an app...
sections.paragraph: For this project, we were tasked with designing an application featuring <mark>innovative interactions.</mark> Taking everyday music streaming apps as our starting point, we had to build a concept that offers users a <mark>completely fresh perspective</mark> on the medium.

sections.label: Benchmark
sections.title: Music streaming apps: our analysis
sections.paragraph:
Analyzing popular music apps revealed that most are heavily player-centric and recommend almost exclusively mainstream, well-known artists.

We also found that suggestions are heavily reliant on the user's existing listening habits, which locks them into an echo chamber and discourages exploration of new genres or artists.

sections.caption: Screen analysis of existing music streaming applications.

sections.title: Defining the problem
sections.paragraph: This led us to ask: <mark>how can we broaden our musical horizons</mark> when mainstream streaming platforms deliberately keep us inside a musical echo chamber?

sections.label: Concept
sections.title: The pitch
sections.paragraph: Our concept addresses this challenge by introducing music lovers to <mark>emerging artists</mark> <mark>via their creative process,</mark> through an <mark>intimate application</mark> built for <mark>slow exploration and meaningful connections with creators.</mark>

sections.caption: An app that takes you behind the scenes with emerging artists.

sections.title: Target audiences
sections.paragraph: The application caters equally to <mark>music lovers</mark> and <mark>emerging music artists,</mark> allowing the former to discover fresh talent while giving the latter a platform to gain exposure.

sections.caption: Persona breakdown of the project's two target audiences.

sections.title: What kind of content?
sections.paragraph: We designed this application to showcase a specific type of content: <mark>short, vertical videos offering a behind-the-scenes look at artists,</mark> with a strong focus on their musical creation process.

sections.title: A distinct tone
sections.paragraph:
We wanted the app to deliver an intimate yet respectful experience, built around gentle information flow and contemplative exploration.

To achieve this, we drew inspiration from several apps embodying these values, notably meditation applications.

sections.caption: Inspirational apps that helped shape our user experience.

sections.title: Project scope
sections.paragraph:
Our concept features two applications: the first targets the general public for music discovery, while the second is built for artists to share their content.

Given the limited timeframe of this project, we focused our efforts on the consumer-facing app, as it best illustrates our core concept.

sections.label: Design Process
sections.title: User Experience
sections.paragraph:
We structured the app around one core feature: discovering one random artist per day.

We started by mapping out the features needed to bring our concept and vision to life.

We then used this map to create wireframes, defining the layout of elements across the app's screens.

Because we were committed to delivering calm, gentle information, we spent considerable time iterating on wireframes to ensure there was only one key piece of information per screen.

sections.title: Moodboard
sections.paragraph: To immerse users in the intimacy of the creative process, we recreated <mark>the atmosphere of a recording studio</mark>: the artist is in the booth, viewed from the control room. We chose a <mark>skeuomorphic interface style,</mark> capturing the tactile feel of physical buttons and mechanical controls found on mixing consoles.

sections.caption: Moodboard: recording studio ambiance and skeuomorphic inspirations.

sections.title: Visual Identity
sections.paragraph:
Our goal was to establish visual consistency across the app while allowing artists to express their personality on their personal pages. We built a studio-inspired black, white, and purple palette, while giving each artist the freedom to customize their page using their own accent color.

For the icons, heavily featured on both hardware and our interface, we opted for rounded shapes to soften the mechanical look. Finally, two complementary typefaces ensure clear information hierarchy.

sections.title: Logo
sections.paragraph: Based on the heading typeface, the logo swaps the 'O's for glasses to <mark>play on words</mark> and <mark>resonate with a younger audience.</mark> It is also animated to feel more dynamic.

sections.caption: Animated logo for the Coolisses application.

sections.title: Coolisses Studio
sections.paragraph: We also designed the logo for Coolisses Studio, the companion app for artists. To maintain visual coherence, it <mark>derives from the main logo.</mark> Stars are replaced by gears, and the word 'Studio' highlights <mark>the configuration and backstage management aspect</mark> of the tool.

sections.caption: Animated logo for Coolisses Studio, dedicated to artists.

sections.label: Prototype
sections.title: Bringing the concept to life as a navigable app
sections.paragraph:
Building on our wireframes and visual identity, we designed the user interface screens. Minor layout tweaks helped streamline the interface to foster genuine connections with artists, steering clear of short-form video tropes (minimal infinite scrolling, no sudden content barrage upon opening).

Below is a video walkthrough of the prototype, which served as our foundation for usability testing and interface refinement.

sections.caption: Video overview of the Coolisses app prototype.

sections.label: Usability Testing
sections.title: Protocol design and test moderation
sections.paragraph:
Our usability tests served two main objectives: measure overall app perception and evaluate how well users understood our most unconventional interactions. Because these non-standard mechanics carried a risk of confusion, testing them was crucial to ensure proper adjustments.

To do this, I drafted a test protocol featuring three scenarios combining task-based exercises and questions. During the sessions, I moderated the tests while a teammate took notes.

sections.title: Test Insights
sections.paragraph: The tests confirmed that certain unconventional interactions weren't always intuitive at first glance. To <mark>smooth out the onboarding experience,</mark> we integrated <mark>explanatory tutorials,</mark> shown in the video below.

sections.caption: Overview of the explanatory tutorials added following usability tests.

sections.label: Conclusion
sections.title: Project Takeaways
sections.paragraph: This project allowed us to design a music experience that challenges current platforms by prioritizing intimacy and slow discovery. Usability testing proved essential for fine-tuning our ergonomic choices and striking the right balance between a strong visual identity and accessibility.

sections.paragraph: In the final year of the DNMADE, we were asked to write a <mark>dissertation of about 15,000 characters</mark> on a topic of our choice related to our specialization. It then had to be presented orally to a jury.

title: Violet
description: Illustrating the symbolism of a color

sections.label: Overview
sections.paragraph:
How do you visually represent the symbolism of a color? That was the central question of this project.
My partner and I tried, through a 30-second short film, to represent the symbolism of our chosen color: violet.
sections.role:
Contributed to ideation and filming
Video editing and sound design

sections.label: Research
sections.title: The symbolism of violet
sections.paragraph: To start, we gathered everything that <mark>made us think of violet</mark> and its symbolism.

sections.caption: Moodboard showing the different symbolisms of violet.

sections.label: Ideation
sections.title: Illustrating a symbolism
sections.paragraph: Drawing on the different symbolisms of violet, we explored <mark>various ideas for visual representations.</mark> Four scenes emerged, which we then filmed.

sections.label: Editing
sections.title: Putting the pieces together
sections.paragraph:
Once filming was done, I collected and sorted all the takes and then assembled them. This is also when I created the magic sphere.
I also added the small sounds that build a sound atmosphere supporting the visual representation.

sections.label: Final video
sections.title: An animated illustration...
sections.paragraph: This process allowed us to <mark>represent the symbolism of violet</mark> through visual, animated and sound elements, while <mark>immersing the viewer in the world of this color.</mark>

sections.caption: Short film on the symbolism of violet.

sections.title: Retrospective
sections.paragraph: By going through every stage of making a video, this project gave me a full picture of the process while letting me deepen my mastery of After Effects.
